annotations.title: Show a sender check and its report

description: Show one sender check, for free: status (checking, completed, failed, expired, pending_approval, cancelled) and, once completed, the report (kept 7 days, then score and counts only). Poll it by check_id while check_sender answers checking; list_sender_checks finds older ones. Unknown id: 404 sender_check_not_found.

check_id.description: Check id (sc_...) from check_sender or list_sender_checks.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

name: get_sender_check
